hooks.name: Remind to update docs after code changes

action.prompt: A Python source file was just saved. Check if the change adds, removes, or significantly modifies any public-facing behaviour (new routes, new LLM prompts, new Jenkins API calls, new intent keywords, new .env variables, changed defaults). If yes, note which of these docs likely need updating: README.md, SETUP.md, docs/ARCHITECTURE.md, docs/PROMPTS.md. Only flag genuine changes — skip minor refactors and bug fixes.
